main_text.p: mant, inquit, omnes licet: Bibliothecas mehercule om-nium philosophorum, unus mihi videtur XII Tabularū libellus, si quis legum fontes & capita viderit, & auctoritatis pondere, & utilitatis u-bertate superare. Eôdém-que illa Ciceronis disputatio praeclara pertinet, in libro de Legibus primo, ubi di-sciplinam Iuris scribit penitus ex intima philosophia hauriendam esse. page.notes: The quotation marks (») at the start of the first nine lines are printer's quotation marks, not words, so they are left out. The running head is set in heavy decorative type and cannot be read. The catchword "gnas" is the first word of the next page. The reading "sua" for the word printed "fua" is taken from the long-s convention; the printed letter could also be read as a long s in "fua".
